$comment: The host manifest. typedstandards-host build writes docs/ from it; every path is relative to this file. scripts/sign_records.py writes its records from signing-plan.json; origin, visibility and the comments are written by hand.

registry.$comment: This example's own statement about the signing key of the records it serves, served at https://notebook.typedstandards.org/.well-known/typed-publisher.json. The key is a pseudonymous did:key; this statement does not say who holds it. This registry is not a Typed Standards record, and not an endorsement by the Typed Standards specification or by typedstandards.org, although this host is a subdomain of it. activatedAt is the earliest createdAt among the records this host serves, as the signer states it.

index.$comment: The records this example serves. Until its own records are signed, it serves one: the host template's placeholder note, signed under the template's throwaway key.
